# taba_distributor (Resource)

A distributor: each publication to it is copied to every queue whose name starts with one of the `prefixes`. It holds no messages.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Each publication to "order-events" is copied to every queue whose name starts with "orders-" or "audit-".
resource "taba_distributor" "order_events" {
  name     = "order-events"
  prefixes = ["orders-", "audit-"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name: 1 to 100 characters `A-Za-z0-9_-`, case-sensitive, not ending in `-dead-letter`. Changing it replaces the distributor.
- `prefixes` (List of String) Name prefixes of the queues each publication is copied to (1 to 20, of 1 to 100 characters `A-Za-z0-9_-`). A change applies to the publications after it.

### Optional

- `create_or_update` (Boolean) When creating, take over a topic with this name that already exists instead of failing: it gets the declared `prefixes` and `tags`. A queue with this name is recreated as a distributor only if it holds no message; otherwise nothing changes and the creation fails. Not set: the provider `create_or_update` (default `false`). It is only used when the resource is created; afterwards the resource belongs to this state like any other, and a `destroy` removes it.
- `tags` (Map of String) Telemetry tags (up to 20; key of 1 to 64 and value of 0 to 128 characters `A-Za-z0-9_-.:`). They do not affect behaviour. Default: none.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation date (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Identifier the server gave the distributor.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A distributor is imported by its name.
terraform import taba_distributor.order_events order-events
```
